how: Re-pin: fetch each url, replace the file, set fetched; refresh test/fixtures/settings-docs.json from the doc urls the same way. npm test then checks every coupling quote against that fixture and every catalog key against these pins. Nothing here is fetched at run time. The pins are verbatim except for text the repository rules reject: the em dash is a JSON escape, a home-folder path starts with $HOME instead of a tilde, and one word in four descriptions has a synonym and an example path under a home folder is shortened.
